summary: Backend e2e test suite for the SFTC refactor (AI workouts + H3 territory + run clubs). 17/17 fast tests pass; AI program generation is implemented correctly (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) and proven via backend logs (~95-100s per call, programs persisted), but ALL synchronous POST /api/onboarding/complete and POST /api/workouts/generate-weekly calls TIME OUT on the public ingress before returning a response (read timeout ~100s, AI call ~95-100s). All other endpoints (auth/OTP, runs+anticheat, H3 territory claim/takeover, clubs CRUD, leaderboards, stats) work correctly through the public URL.

critical.issue: Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation takes 95-100s. Backend log shows successful program creation (e.g., 'AI program generated for user=... title=Hypertrophy + Running Performance Program weeks=4'), but the public Kubernetes ingress disconnects the client before the response is flushed. From the public URL the request appears to hang / time out. Tests written with timeout=180s also fail with ReadTimeout. Need to move AI generation to a background task (return job_id + poll endpoint) OR shrink the prompt so Claude returns in <60s.

minor.issue: Backend logs spam 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' on every register due to passlib<>bcrypt version mismatch. Functionality not affected, but log noise is significant. Pin passlib[bcrypt] or downgrade bcrypt.

Defaults to user.profile.city which is missing for freshly-registered users (returns 'Your City'); endpoint requires the caller to pass ?city= explicitly. Not a bug per se, but documenting expected behavior.

Single uvicorn worker means an in-flight AI generation blocks all subsequent requests. Once /onboarding/complete is queued, /terra/runs returns instantly only after the AI call finishes (seen in logs: anti-cheat verdict logged at exact same second as AI completion). Recommend running uvicorn with workers>=2 or background AI.

action_items: Move AI program generation off the request path - return 202 + job_id, expose GET /api/workouts/program-status; client polls. Alternatively, kick off the AI call in a background task and immediately return the rules_engine fallback as the visible plan, then replace it asynchronously.
Reduce Claude prompt size / output size or pre-warm the model so a single call returns in <60s.
Pin bcrypt or passlib to silence the bcrypt __about__ warning.
Configure uvicorn with multiple workers (--workers 2+) so long synchronous AI calls do not stall other requests.
After moving AI to background, re-enable the TestOnboardingAI test class (5 tests currently erroring because the session fixture times out via ingress).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/workouts.py: /onboarding/complete and /workouts/generate-weekly are synchronous, blocking, multi-minute AI calls served under the request lifecycle. This is the root cause of ingress timeouts. Refactor to async background task pattern.
/app/backend/territory/h3_grid.py: cells_for_path has redundant 'if cell not in seen: seen[cell] = None' after the loop block - dead code, harmless but should be cleaned.

/app/backend/server.py: Only the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set in /app/frontend/.env (no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). System prompt expects REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Confirm whether this is intentional for Expo client; otherwise add an alias.
Anti-cheat returns valid=False but the server still inserts the run doc (with empty cells). That is fine for analytics, but the contract returns claim={claimed:[]} which is correctly tested.

success_rate.backend: 94% (17/18 endpoints) - AI-program endpoint untestable via public URL

test_credentials: Created on the fly. Pattern: alex+<ts>@example.com / Pass1234!  and rival+<ts>@example.com / Pass1234!. OTPs read from db.otps.
seed_data_creation: Test runs (~3 valid Hyd loops), 1 run club created+deleted per session. ~3 test users per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` from /app. The TestOnboardingAI class will hang/error until /onboarding/complete is converted to a background-task pattern. Everything else runs in ~4s. To exercise the AI path WITHOUT public ingress, hit the backend directly: curl http://localhost:8001/api/onboarding/complete ... it returns successfully in ~95s (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). The pipeline (workout_ai.generate_program -> persist_program) is functional.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA for AI timeout: Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations takes 90-100s. The Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress in this preview environment has a ~100s upstream read timeout. The request flushes no bytes during AI inference, so the proxy closes the client connection just before/after FastAPI writes the response. Reproduction: time `curl https://4dab4e2c-2afb-4ed4-8bd5-9ad84ac0fbd8.preview.emergentagent.com/api/onboarding/complete -H 'Authorization: Bearer <tok>' -d '{"profile":{...},"generate_program":true}'` -> times out, but backend log shows 'AI program generated' and the program/workouts are persisted in Mongo. Mitigation: convert /onboarding/complete and /workouts/generate-weekly to enqueue a background task (FastAPI BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task storing status in db.training_programs.status='generating'), return 202 immediately with program_id, expose GET /api/workouts/program-status/{id} for the client to poll.
